app.title: ShramkoGSFPV — fly
loading.stage.both: Downloading the scan and its walls
loading.stage.partial: Showing what has arrived so far
loading.next: Next: choose how you will fly.
loading.readyAsk: The scan is ready. How will you fly?
loading.stall: No data for {s} s. The server is slow right now; still waiting.
loading.stallLong: No data for {s} s. Try again, or choose another scan.
loading.stallPrepare: Preparing the view is taking longer than usual ({s} s).
loading.failed: Part of the scan could not be downloaded.
preflight.title: Checking your browser
preflight.noWebgpu: You can look around, but flying needs Chrome or Edge with WebGPU. Open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer.
preflight.noHid: Radios over USB work only in Chrome and Edge. Here you can fly with a gamepad or touch sticks.
warning.title: Before you fly
warning.text: Fast flight and crashes can cause motion sickness. Measured over 50 crashes, crash effects flash at most 2 times per second (the WCAG limit is 3); motion is reduced if your system asks for reduced motion. Take a break if you feel unwell.
scenes.title: Choose a scan
scenes.paste: Paste a SuperSplat link or scene id
scenes.empty.favourites: Tap the star on a scan to keep it here.
scenes.noCollisionBadge: Scan without walls: you can fly around, but you cannot crash
scenes.noCollisionLine: Walls exist only in scans that have collision data. This one has none yet.
scenes.byAuthor: Scene by its author — see the original on SuperSplat
scenes.unsupported: This scene is stored in SuperSplat's older PLY format, which the simulator cannot open yet. Scenes in the current format open fine.
error.invalid-link: This is not a SuperSplat link or scene id. Paste a link like superspl.at/scene/39e63ce9.
error.not-found: This scene does not exist on SuperSplat or is not public.
error.network: The SuperSplat servers did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
error.blocked: This scene was removed at its author's request.
drone.title: Your drone
drone.clearance: Closest approach to a wall on this scan: about {mm} mm from the centre
drone.sourceNote: Every number shows where it comes from.
radio.title: Controls
radio.hidHint: Plug the radio in, choose "USB Joystick". Switch the RF module off — reports then arrive up to 1000 times a second.
radio.touchHint: Good for looking around and showing friends. To learn to fly, use a radio.
radio.keyboardHint: Space arms. W / S throttle, A / D yaw, arrows pitch and roll, M turns self-levelling on or off.
radio.moveStick: Move a stick to detect the device
radio.real: Real radios: not tested yet in this version. The wizard is tested with a simulated EdgeTX radio.
wizard.heading: Set up your radio
wizard.mode.1: Mode 1: throttle on the right stick
wizard.mode.2: Mode 2: throttle on the left stick
wizard.modeAsk: Which stick is your throttle, the one that stays where you leave it?
wizard.say.check: Check: the drawing follows your sticks
wizard.sub.stir: Round and round, all the way to the edges, until all four bars are green. Then press Done.
wizard.sub.centre: Thumbs off, throttle all the way down. Then press Measure.
wizard.sub.L.up: Left stick up, all the way. Hold it there.
wizard.sub.R.up: Right stick up, all the way. Hold it there.
wizard.sub.L.right: Left stick to the right, all the way. Hold it there.
wizard.sub.R.right: Right stick to the right, all the way. Hold it there.
wizard.sub.L.down: Left stick all the way down.
wizard.sub.R.down: Right stick all the way down.
wizard.sub.L.let: Take your thumb off the left stick.
wizard.sub.R.let: Take your thumb off the right stick.
wizard.sub.arm.on: The switch you arm with: ON, hold it a moment, then OFF. A button works too: press it once.
wizard.sub.arm.off: Try it: ON lights up Arm, OFF puts it out. Leave it OFF, then press Next.
wizard.sub.check: Move the sticks: the knobs and bars must follow. Then press Fly.
wizard.hint.noData: No data from the radio yet. On the radio choose USB Joystick (not USB Storage), then wait a second.
wizard.hint.badReport: The radio sends {len}-byte reports we cannot read. In the radio's model settings set USB Joystick mode to Classic.
wizard.hint.stir.few: Only {n} channels move like sticks. We need 4. Is the radio in USB Joystick mode?
wizard.hint.stir.coverage: CH{ch} has reached only {pct} % of its travel. Push that stick all the way to both ends.
wizard.hint.stir.other: Now stir the other stick too, into every corner. If it moves but no new bar below turns green, set the radio to USB Joystick mode.
wizard.hint.centre.moving: CH{ch} is still moving. Take your thumbs off and wait a second.
wizard.hint.push.none: Nothing has moved far enough yet. Push all the way to the edge and hold.
wizard.hint.push.short: Almost: you reached {pct} %. Push all the way and hold.
wizard.hint.push.two: CH{a} and CH{b} both move. Push straight, not diagonally.
wizard.hint.push.taken: That moves {fn}, which is already set. Follow the drawing.
wizard.hint.arm.none: No switch has moved. Your radio's model probably has no switch on a channel yet.
wizard.hint.arm.small: CH{ch} moved only a little. Flip the switch all the way, or pick CH{ch} by hand.
wizard.hint.check.throttle: The throttle shows {pct} % while the stick rests. If the stick is down, press Reverse on Throttle.
wizard.howto.title: To put a switch on channel 5 (EdgeTX):
wizard.howto.1: On the radio open the model settings and go to the MIXES page.
wizard.howto.2: Select CH5, edit it, choose Source and flip the switch you want: it fills in by itself.
wizard.howto.3: Leave the menu, come back here and flip the switch.
wizard.howto.skip: No switch at all? Skip this step: you will arm with the Space key or the ARM button on the screen.
wizard.reverseHint: A bar or knob moves the wrong way? Press Reverse on its line: it switches at once.
wizard.pick.title: Which channel moves when you push {fn}? Click it.
wizard.check.throttle: Throttle all the way down: the throttle bar is empty
wizard.check.arm: Flip the arm switch: Arm lights up
wizard.check.armToggle: Press the arm button: Arm lights up
wizard.check.armKey: Arm with Space or the ARM button
wizard.check.centre: Sticks let go: the knobs sit in the middle
wizard.check.armNowHint: Set the arm switch where you fly disarmed: here it must say OFF. Says ON? Press Reverse on the Arm line.
wizard.oldProfile: This setup was made by an older version of the wizard. If anything looks wrong, set it up again.
wizard.kbd: Enter or Space: the green button · Backspace: back · Esc: close
arm.card.title: To arm
arm.hint: Throttle all the way down — that's how a real drone arms.
arm.blocked.center: Move each stick through its centre once.
arm.blocked.throttle: Throttle all the way down to arm.
arm.blocked.switch: Turn the arm switch off, then on.
arm.blocked.hidden: The page is in the background.
arm.blocked.throttleKey: Hold S until the throttle is all the way down, then press Space.
arm.blocked.centerKey: Let go of the arrow keys and A / D.
arm.blocked.switchTouch: Tap {btn} at the bottom to arm.
arm.blocked.throttleTouch: Slide the left pad all the way down, then tap {btn}.
arm.keys.title: Keyboard
arm.keys.throttle: throttle up / down, stays where you leave it
hud.keys: R respawn · P pause · H hide text · F3 screen and delay
hud.keysKbd: Space arm · W/S throttle · A/D yaw · arrows pitch/roll · M angle/acro · R respawn · P pause · H hide text
hud.textOff: Text hidden · H brings it back
hud.stats: screen {hz} Hz · input → screen ≈ {ms} ms · physics 1000 Hz
hud.slowDisplay: Your screen runs at {hz} Hz, so every frame adds {p} ms of delay. Connect it by DisplayPort and choose 60 Hz: the delay drops by about half.
crash.title: Crash at {speed}
pause.title: Paused
settings.title: Settings
settings.qualityHint: Moves the render resolution and detail budget. Physics always runs at 1000 Hz.
settings.gravityWarning: With the same motors under {g} m/s² the craft has about {x}× the thrust-to-weight it has on Earth: it will be very twitchy. "Keep thrust / weight" makes it feel normal. The air is Earth air everywhere — gravity is a game setting here.
replays.title: Replays
replays.empty: Crashes and saved flights appear here.
replays.mismatch: This replay was recorded with a different version of the flight model and cannot be played exactly.
measure.title: Measurements
measure.note: We show our own numbers because nobody else publishes theirs. The display adds at least one refresh: ~{hz} Hz means at least {ms} ms. Stick-to-photon latency with a camera has not been measured yet.
touch.hint: Left pad: throttle and yaw. Right pad: pitch and roll.
wizard.needFourAxes: We need four sticks that move. Move both sticks all the way in every direction.
banner.noHid: Radios over USB work in Chrome and Edge. Here: gamepad or touch sticks.
banner.noWebgpu: This browser has no WebGPU. You can look at the scan, but flying needs Chrome or Edge on a computer.
bake.done: Walls built in this browser: {voxels} million voxels in {s} s. Crashes are on.
bake.refused: This scan has {n} million Gaussians; the browser can build walls for up to {max} million. You fly without walls.
bake.refine.long: Refine walls to {cm} cm: long, about {min} min
bake.refine.confirm: About {min} min of full GPU and CPU load, the fans will spin. Click again to start.
bake.refine.done: Walls refined to {cm} cm (were {was} cm) in {s} s. They go in at the next respawn or restart.
bake.refine.swapped: Walls refined: {cm} cm (were {was} cm). In use now.
bake.refine.failed: Could not refine the walls: {msg}. You fly on the {was} cm walls.
bake.refine.refused: Finer walls are not built in the browser for this scan: {n} million Gaussians, the limit here is {max} million.
bake.cached: Walls {cm} cm from this browser's store, no rebuild.
bake.empty: The GPU returned empty walls: they were not used, the old walls stay.
bake.noWebgpu: Building walls needs WebGPU (Chrome or Edge).
bake.store.info: Stored in this browser: {mb} MB of walls, scans: {n}. Export them to carry them to another PC.
bake.store.memory: This window does not keep walls (private window or storage blocked): they last until the tab closes.
bake.store.empty: No walls stored in this browser yet.
cinema.on: Cinema mode: full detail, no automatic quality. The scene credit is burned into the video.
cinema.noRec: Cinema mode: full detail. Recording is available for the showcase scans only — their authors agreed to it.
import.title: Import from Betaflight
import.hint: Paste the output of "diff" or "diff all" from the Betaflight CLI. Rates and PID of the active profiles are applied to the simulated drone; nothing is sent anywhere.
import.ok: Imported from {fw}: {type} rates and PID. Warnings: {w}.
wizard.say.stir.active: Stir both sticks into every corner
wizard.say.throttle.ready: Throttle: all the way down, then Start
wizard.say.arm.ready: Arm switch: put it OFF, then Start
wizard.say.arm.active: Flip your arm switch ON, then back OFF
wizard.sub.arm.ready: The switch you will arm with, in its disarmed position.
wizard.gauge.wait: Push the stick the way the drawing shows
wizard.result.centre: Centres (0 % = the middle of the travel):
wizard.result.end: CH{ch} rests at its end: that is the throttle.
wizard.result.inv: This channel runs the other way round; the simulator turns it round.
wizard.result.letGo: Let go of the stick, then press Next.
wizard.result.thrDown: Bring the throttle all the way down, then press Next.
wizard.result.armTry: Flip it ON and OFF: the light must follow. Leave it OFF, then press Next.
wizard.hint.begin.moving: CH{ch} is still moving. Hands off for a second, then Start.
wizard.hint.begin.held: Let go of CH{ch} first: it is at {pct} %.
wizard.hint.begin.parked: CH{ch} stays at {pct} %. Let go of it, or if it is the throttle, put it all the way down. Then Start.
wizard.hint.centre.ends: CH{a} and CH{b} are held at their ends. Let go of the sticks.
wizard.hint.centre.parked: CH{ch} stays at {pct} %. Let go of it, or if it is the throttle, put it all the way down.
wizard.hint.centre.held: Let go of CH{ch}: it is at {pct} %.
wizard.hint.next.held: Let go of the {fn} stick first: it is at {pct} %.
wizard.hint.next.moving: The {fn} stick is still moving. Wait a second.
wizard.hint.next.thrDown: The throttle reads {pct} %. Pull it all the way down. Already down? Press Reverse.
wizard.hint.next.armOn: Arm reads ON. Flip the switch OFF. Already OFF? Press Reverse.
wizard.hint.push.hold: Push all the way and hold it until the ring is full. Was the throttle up when you pressed Start? Put it down, press Back, then Start.
wizard.hint.arm.wasOn: CH{ch}: flip it ON, hold it a moment, then back OFF. Was it ON when you pressed Start? Put it OFF, press Back, then Start.
wizard.hint.stir.short: CH{ch} stops at {pct} %. If your radio limits it, press Done; otherwise stir to the very edges.
wizard.say.arm.key: You will arm with Space or the ARM button
wizard.sub.arm.back: Back to OFF and hold it there a moment: when the ring is full, it is taken.
wizard.sub.arm.key: No switch needed. Press Next; you can still pick a switch channel below.
wizard.result.armKey: In flight, Space or the ARM button on the screen arms and disarms.
wizard.arm.nothing: No switch has flipped yet. Only a flip after Start counts.
wizard.arm.listening: Listening to CH{ch} only. Back listens to every channel again.
wizard.arm.pickTitle: Or pick the channel you arm with:
wizard.arm.pickOther: Wrong channel? Pick the one you arm with:
wizard.arm.pickSwitch: Have a switch after all? Pick its channel:
wizard.arm.pickHint: Click a channel, then flip the switch ON and back OFF.
wizard.hint.arm.sweep: CH{ch} moved smoothly, like a knob or a slider, not like a switch. Flip a switch; if you really arm with CH{ch}, pick it by hand.
wizard.hint.arm.wasOnBtn: Let go of button {btn} now. Was it held down when you pressed Start? Let go, press Back, then Start.
